S
Out of Fort Lauderdale–Hollywood International Airport
Flight arrives 8:30 am. We allow 1 h 15 min to get off the plane and through baggage claim (and passport control after a flight from abroad). Book luggage storage near Fort Lauderdale–Hollywood International Airport ahead (a left-luggage desk or a storage shop), or ask your hotel or station.
You fly in the day the ship sails. A late or missed flight is the most common way travelers miss a ship, and the ship won't wait: if your flight is delayed, skip the sightseeing and go straight to the port.

Boarding at Cruise Terminal 4
18 min to spare.
Official all aboard 3:30 pm: be at the terminal by 2:30 pm at the latest. Your cruise line gives you a boarding time: add it and the plan gets you there for it.
Porters take your big bags at the curb (luggage tags on; they reach your cabin by evening). Keep your passport, boarding pass, medicines and valuables in your carry-on for check-in and security.
Big ports have more than one cruise terminal: check yours on your boarding pass and tell the driver.
Book the taxi or transfer the day before, or ask your hotel to call one. Being aboard on time is your responsibility: check your boarding time with your cruise line.

Download for offline

This device has no voice of its own, so only the recorded stories play aloud. Every story is still on screen. Only a short written guide for some stops in Fort Lauderdale (2), Nassau (3) and Grand Turk (3).

What's saved, day by day
How offline works

Setting up a trip needs the internet: building guides, finding places to eat, ratings, ride timetables and recording the stories. Once it's planned, tap Download for offline on Wi-Fi and the whole trip runs with no signal: the Day plan, street maps, the guide and its stories, ride times and the back-to-the-ship countdown.

Kairoute uses about 19 MB on this phone.

Privacy

Draft, lawyer review before launch. Not yet reviewed by a lawyer; it will be before Kairoute is sold or published in an app store.

Effective November 10, 2026

Kairoute is built to keep your trip yours. This policy explains what the app stores, what it sends, and the choices you have.

What stays on your device
Your trips, itineraries, hotels, cruise details and preferences.
City guides the app has built for you.
Your journal: notes, ratings and photos.

The preview has no accounts. We do not see this information unless you share it.

What is sent to provide the AI guide

When you build a guide, import an itinerary, ask the guide a question or translate a story, the text or photo you provide is sent to our AI provider to produce the answer. Do not include passport numbers, payment details or other sensitive information in itinerary photos.

Location

Kairoute uses your device's location only if you allow it: to show where you are on the day's map, to notice when you reach a stop on the tour, and to time the back-to-the-ship countdown from where you are. To work out the walk or ride from there, that starting point is sent to Kairoute's helper. If you lead a group trip, a regroup call shares your location with the group. You can turn location off at any time in your device's settings.

What we do not do
We do not sell your personal information.
We do not show third-party ads or use advertising trackers.
We do not build a profile of you for marketing.
Sharing a trip

When you share or export a trip, the people you send it to can see everything in it. Shared copies are under their control.

Deleting your data

Delete a single trip from the home screen, or clear everything in Settings, Start over. Uninstalling the app or clearing your browser data also removes it.

Children

Kairoute is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their information.

Changes and contact

If this policy changes, we will update the date above and tell you in the app. Questions: wovenleafapps@gmail.com.

Draft, lawyer review before launch. Not yet reviewed by a lawyer; it will be before Kairoute is sold or published in an app store.

Effective November 20, 2026

By using Kairoute you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.

A planning guide with estimated times

Kairoute suggests routes, times, places to eat and stories about the sights. Opening hours, prices, port times, transit and closures change. Always confirm important details with the venue, your cruise line, airline or rail operator.

Getting back on time is your responsibility

Leave-by times, back-by times and countdowns are estimates. Kairoute pads them with spare time (on a port day it plans you back at least 45 minutes before all aboard), but traffic, queues, weather, strikes and changes to timetables can still make a trip take longer.

The official time is always the one your cruise line, airline or rail operator gives you: the ship's all-aboard time, your boarding time or your departure. Kairoute shows the ship's all-aboard time next to its own times so you can check them against each other. Confirm it on the day, as it can change.

You are responsible for being back aboard your ship, at your gate or on your train on time. Kairoute is not liable for missed ships, flights, trains, connections, tours or bookings, or for any costs that follow from them.

AI content

Guides, translations and answers may be written with the help of AI and can contain mistakes. Use your judgment, and do not rely on the app for medical, legal or safety advice.

Stay safe

Watch where you walk, follow local laws and posted rules, and be aware of your surroundings. Do not use the app while driving.

Entrance fees and tickets

Prices shown are estimates. Entrance fees, tickets, rides and meals are not included in the price of Kairoute.

Third parties

Kairoute is not affiliated with any cruise line, airline, railway, museum or restaurant it mentions. Links to other sites are provided for convenience.

Your content

Your journal entries and photos remain yours. You give Kairoute permission to store and process them only to run the app for you.

Our content

The Kairoute name, logo, design and guide content belong to Kairoute and may not be copied or resold.

Limitation of liability

To the extent the law allows, Kairoute is provided "as is" without warranties, and our total liability is limited to the amount you paid for the app in the past 12 months.

Changes and contact

We may update these terms and will note the new date above. Contact details will be added here before launch.
